title: Loan payment calculator with amortization schedule
when: The user wants to compute the monthly payment, total interest and payoff schedule of a loan, mortgage or financing, with optional extra payments.
prompt:
Goal: A payment figure that matches the standard formula and a schedule whose final balance is exactly zero.
Steps:
1. Labeled number inputs with min and step: principal, annual rate percent, term in years or months, extra monthly payment.
2. logic.mjs: payment(P, pct, n) = P r / (1 - (1 + r)^-n) with r = pct / 1200, or P / n at 0 percent.
3. schedule(P, pct, n, extra) returns rows { month, payment, interest, principal, balance } in cents; trim the last payment so balance ends at 0.
4. Summary: monthly payment, total paid, total interest, payoff month and months saved by extra payments.
5. Schedule table with th headers and yearly subtotals, scrolling inside a wrapper; an SVG principal versus interest bar with role="img" and a title.
6. Note under results: estimate only, fees and taxes not included.
7. test.mjs: 200,000 at 6 percent over 360 gives 1199.10, zero rate, final balance 0.
Quality bar:
- Money rounded per row in cents.
- Schedule rows sum to total paid.
- Works for 1 to 480 months.
Pitfalls:
- Percent used as a fraction twice.
- A negative last balance.
- Rendering 360 rows at once without yearly grouping.
Verify:
- [ ] Formula tested with a known case.
- [ ] Inputs labeled with number types.
- [ ] Table uses th.
- [ ] node test.mjs passes.
Output: index.html, style.css, app.js, logic.mjs (payment and schedule), test.mjs.

examples.input: simulador de financiamento com tabela de parcelas
examples.output: payment 1.199,10, total interest, yearly schedule, extra payment saves 54 months
